standard.summary: 给低显存卡一个显式的 Triton 保守模式，避免首步在线 autotune 把临时池顶爆。
standard.effect: off 保持现有 Triton 行为。conservative 会让支持的 fused LoRA / QKV / FFN 内核绕开在线 autotune，改用单一保守 launch config。
standard.whenToUse: 8GB 或更紧张的显存卡，已经确认开启 Triton fused 路线但首步容易 OOM 时手动启用。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存充足且追求最高吞吐时。conservative 主要是救峰值，不保证最快。

optionDescriptions.off: 低显存 autotune 特殊模式关。
optionDescriptions.conservative: autotune 偏保守，优先别 OOM。

standard_en.summary: Gives low-VRAM cards an explicit conservative Triton mode, so online autotune on the first step cannot blow out the temporary pool.
standard_en.effect: off keeps the existing Triton behaviour. conservative makes the supported fused LoRA / QKV / FFN kernels skip online autotune and use a single conservative launch config instead.
standard_en.whenToUse: On 8GB or tighter cards, enabled by hand once you have confirmed the Triton fused path is on but the first step tends to OOM.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When VRAM is plentiful and you want the highest throughput. conservative is mainly there to save the peak; it does not promise to be the fastest.

optionDescriptions.off: The low-VRAM autotune special mode is off.
optionDescriptions.conservative: Autotune leans conservative, avoiding OOM before anything else.

advanced.principle: Triton 在线 autotune 会在首个真实 shape 上尝试多组 kernel config，常见现象是第一步 temporary pool / reserved memory 突然抬高。该开关不会自动替用户判断显存，而是提供一个显式 opt-in：conservative 时直接跳过在线 autotune，使用预选的低峰值单配置。
advanced.intervention: 训练器在 Triton 注入阶段读取 low_vram_autotune_mode；conservative 会透传到 fused kernel 调用路径，切换到单配置 launch。
advanced.expectedImpact: 降低首步显存峰值和 temporary pool 暴涨概率，特别适合 8GB 卡。代价是部分 shape 下吞吐可能低于 autotune 最优配置。
advanced.tradeoffs: 它只影响接入了该策略的 Triton fused 路线；如果本次训练没开 Triton，或瓶颈不在 autotune 峰值，这个开关不会带来收益。

advanced_en.principle: Triton's online autotune tries multiple kernel configs on the first real shape; the common symptom is the first step's temporary pool / reserved memory suddenly jumping. This switch does not auto-judge VRAM for the user — it provides an explicit opt-in: conservative skips online autotune entirely, using a pre-picked low-peak single config.
advanced_en.intervention: The trainer reads low_vram_autotune_mode at the Triton injection stage; conservative passes through to the fused-kernel call path, switching to single-config launch.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Lowers first-step VRAM peak and the chance of a temporary-pool explosion — especially good for 8GB cards. The cost is throughput possibly below autotune's optimum on some shapes.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: It only affects Triton fused routes wired to this policy; if the run doesn't use Triton or the bottleneck isn't the autotune peak, this switch gains nothing.
